card.title: PlayStation 5 Disk to Digital Conversion
symptoms: can't reinstall firmware without paired drive

claims.statement: The PS5 disc drive is paired to the board; if the drive's Renesas chip fails or a disc board lacks its drive, firmware updates fail (e.g. SU-101312-8); as of May 2025 a new drive can't be paired.
The fix on original (fat) PS5 is converting the NOR to Digital: at offset 0x1C7011 change 02 to 03 and at 0x1C7038 change 89 to 8D, then write back and reinstall firmware.

procedure: Remove and dump the 25Q16JVNIM BIOS; back it up.
In a hex editor set 0x1C7011 = 03 and 0x1C7038 = 8D.
Write the modified dump and resolder.
Reinstall PS5 system software; test PSN and a digital game.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Keep an untouched backup of the original NOR dump.
card.caveats: Only valid for the original (fat) PS5 per the source. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
